data.title: Excavator And Dump Truck
data.description: Hop into the driver seat to scoop dirt with the excavator and fill the big dump truck for a special delivery.

challenges.instruction: Put 4 scoops of gravel in the dump truck for the new playground, then send the truck.
Put 2 scoops of dirt in the dump truck for the central park path, then send the truck.
Put 5 scoops of rocks in the dump truck for the community garden beds, then send the truck.
Put 7 scoops of sand in the dump truck for the sunny picnic area, then send the truck.
Put 3 scoops of gravel in the dump truck for the rolling grassy hill, then send the truck.
